# SpawnSweep

> SpawnSweep is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app for cleaning up after AI coding agents. It finds leftover dev servers, busy ports, Git worktrees, simulators and Docker stacks. Resources are associated with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI or Aider sessions when detected. Manual cleanup starts with a preview.

- Platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon. Native SwiftUI.
- Price: free and open source (MIT). SpawnSweep Pro is a one-time $9 purchase for up to 3 Macs and adds a junk cleaner, large & old files, and Autopilot rules that act on their own.
- Privacy: cleanup scans run locally and the app collects no usage telemetry. Pro contacts Dodo Payments for license activation, validation and deactivation.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/samirmaikap/spawnsweep/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`, or download SpawnSweep.zip from the latest GitHub release.
- Made by Samir Maikap.

## Docs

- [Website](https://samirmaikap.dev/spawnsweep/): what SpawnSweep finds, how it compares, Pro, safety rules
- [FAQ](https://samirmaikap.dev/spawnsweep/#faq): freeing a port on a Mac, stopping dev servers agents left running, cleaning git worktrees and Xcode simulators
- [README](https://github.com/samirmaikap/spawnsweep#readme): features, install, safety rules, helpers (MCP server, Claude Code SessionEnd hook)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/samirmaikap/spawnsweep/releases/latest): download and release notes
- [Security reporting](https://github.com/samirmaikap/spawnsweep/security/policy): private reporting and release verification
- [OpenMacApps](https://openmacapps.com/apps/spawnsweep/) and [AlternativeTo](https://alternativeto.net/software/spawnsweep/about/): third-party product listings
